title: Päijät-Häme: 0.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €41,000 a year
markdown:
# Päijät-Häme: 0.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €41,000 a year

> 0.5 more patients a year treated to cure · €41,000 of €1.00M · €959,000 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Päijät-Häme, 30 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 1.0 patient a year is missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 0.0–5.6) [^care_curative][^model]. Compared with Finland as a whole the estimated shortfall is 0.0 patients a year (range 0.0–1.2), so there is nothing to split between surgery and radiotherapy [^care_curative][^model].

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 29.6% to 30.0% by 2028: 0.5 more patients a year (range 0.0–0.5), for €41,000 a year, about €82,000 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 1 | **A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 0.5 (0.0–0.5) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 11.8% → 12.2% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€41,000** | **0.5 (0.0–0.5)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €633,566 a year; modelled to avoid 1.1 deaths a year (0.2–2.8). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 29.6% (2019–2023, measured) → 30.0% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 11.8% → 12.2% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €959,000 buys nothing more in the model [^model]. The access measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money [^model]. More could come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided instead [^model]. Lung cancer causes about 104 deaths a year in Päijät-Häme, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.1 of them [^deaths][^model].

## Limits

- Effects are assumptions, not trial results. The range runs from every assumption at its lowest to every assumption at its highest, and it is not a probability [^model].
- The comparison with the expected share is adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, histology, smoking or how the cancer was found. County figures cannot show cause [^model].
- The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured, and is only a secondary view [^model]. A check against measured outcomes confirmed none of three expected links [^model].

removed.sentence: This plan does not use the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock.
removed.reason: The source does not state that the plan does not use the clock; it says the clock is an estimated, secondary view. Replaced with that supported statement so the next sentence keeps its reference.

flagged.sentence: Compared with Finland as a whole there is no shortfall, so there is nothing to split between surgery and radiotherapy [^care_curative][^model].
flagged.reason: This presented an estimate as certain. The source gives 0.0 patients a year with a range of 0.0–1.2 and marks no_shortfall as false. Rewritten as an estimate with its range.

flagged.sentence: The remaining €959,000 buys nothing more in the model.
flagged.reason: The sentence had a figure and claim but no source marker. Added [^model], which is the obvious source (plan saturation note).

flagged.sentence: The shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, histology, smoking or how the cancer was found.
flagged.reason: The measured shares are not adjusted at all. Only the expected-share comparison is adjusted, and only for the share of residents aged 65 or over. Rewritten so the measured shares are not described as adjusted.
